title: Find Me
track_note: Primary audio: assets/find_me/track.mp3 (I Like It Like That). Timings scale from scaffold_duration_sec.
style: Sophisticated comic-book digital art — steampunk brass/copper + cyberpunk neon + synthwave grid. Rain-slicked noir, dark ink lines, graphic-novel shadows, cross-hatching, neon rim light. NOT photoreal. Hero likeness from reference rendered in this art style only.
story: Deep isolation under neon rain — she searches a fragmented steampunk-cyber city, catches a purple signal, sprints through copper mazes, finds holographic ghosts in a glass conservatory, then leaps into a neon vortex to reconnect before the void shatters.
pacing_profile: Cinematic contrast: low-fi emotional isolation → sharp high-velocity kinetic pursuit → ethereal breakdown → finale reconnection.
